name: Le Méridien Phuket Beach Resort
short_description: A large, long-running Le Méridien resort on a secluded cove near Karon and Relax Bay, currently mid-renovation, about 42 km from the airport.
ai_summary: Le Méridien Phuket Beach Resort occupies a secluded 40-acre cove near Karon (Relax Bay / Karon Noi), one of the island's older large-scale resorts, open since 1987 with roughly 470 rooms and suites across ten restaurants and bars. Guest reviews describe genuinely strong hospitality, a standout private beach with light waves, a large pool, and a wide range of sports and activities, and it's consistently one of the most-booked hotels in Phuket. The clear caveat as of mid-2026 is that the resort is undergoing renovation: guest reports describe some rooms as dated and in need of refurbishment, a 'mass-tourism' atmosphere with average-quality food at its more casual restaurants, and -- during renovation phases -- guests paying full price while only part of the pools and restaurants are open. Prospective bookers should check current renovation status and which facilities are operating before committing, since the beach and grounds are consistently well-reviewed but the physical product is older than the newer Mai Khao-area Bonvoy resorts. At roughly 42 km from the airport, it's also one of the farther Phuket properties in this directory, reflecting its more central west-coast location near Patong and Karon rather than the northern beaches.

faqs.question: Is Le Méridien Phuket Beach Resort currently under renovation?
faqs.answer: As of mid-2026, guest reports describe ongoing renovation work with some facilities, pools, and restaurants temporarily closed or reduced in scope. Confirm current renovation status directly with the hotel before booking if facility access is a priority.

faqs.question: Where exactly is Le Méridien Phuket Beach Resort located?
faqs.answer: It sits on a secluded cove near Karon (also referred to as Relax Bay or Karon Noi) on Phuket's west coast, roughly 42 km from Phuket International Airport and a short distance from Patong.

reviews.title: Review: Le Méridien Phuket Beach Resort
reviews.author: Claire
reviews.summary: First-hand review of the 40-acre, 470-room resort on private Relax Beach: two oversized pools, ~10 dining venues, Le Spa, tennis and kids/teen clubs; ~67% of rooms have ocean or pool views.

reviews.title: Le Méridien Phuket Beach Resort Review
reviews.author: Andrew John Virtue Dobson
reviews.summary: Three-night stay on private Karon Noi Beach: teakwood-and-Thai-silk rooms, restaurants from Ariake to Portofino, a Latest Recipe local feast, and easy taxi access to Patong. Framed as affordable luxury.

reviews.title: A Photo Review of Le Méridien Phuket Beach Resort
reviews.author: Brad
reviews.summary: Upgraded to a junior suite with beach views; praises the private Andaman beach, Thai/Italian/Japanese dining and free SPG breakfast, but calls the hotel a bit dated and notes the remote, taxi-dependent location.

reviews.title: Le Meridien Phuket Beach Resort review: beachfront stay in Phuket
reviews.author: Chantelle Ellem
reviews.summary: Family-focused review: Hawaii-like feel near Karon, calm protected private beach, multiple pools, eight standout restaurants, and ~70% ocean-view rooms. Would return, especially for family travel. (Hosted stay, own opinions.)

reviews.title: Hotel Review: Le Meridien Phuket Beach Resort
reviews.author: milespointstravel
reviews.summary: SPG Category 4 stay: room upgrade, spacious ocean-view rooms and the only private beach in Phuket, but flags the isolated captive-audience location and a bout of food poisoning after dinner on-site.
